Fans Go Crazy After Swae Lee Makes A Stop At A College For The Rolling Loud Movie Tour 🎓🔥

Swae Lee Pulled Up To A College Stop For The Rolling Loud: The Movie Tour, And The Crowd Went Absolutely Crazy When He Made His Appearance. 🎤🔥

The Surprise Visit Is Part Of The Hype Building Around The Movie, Which Hits Theaters On October 2nd. Starring Owen Wilson And Matt Rife, The Film Also Features Travis Scott As Himself, Along With Appearances From Sexyy Red, Ski Mask The Slump God And Ty Dolla $ign. 🎬👀

With Artists Like Swae Lee Helping Bring The Movie To College Campuses, Rolling Loud Is Turning The Release Into A Full-On Experience Before It Even Hits Theaters. 🔥
